verdict.rationale: Zoho Books publishes a structured REST API reference with per-endpoint pages (e.g. Create a Contact, Verify a Contact Bank Account, Create an organization) and documented OAuth setup. It also offers a downloadable full OpenAPI document, which could be imported into third-party tools to run requests. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or has runnable examples. missing for 10: an in-browser 'try it' console or runnable examples, evidence of copy-paste request samples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
